'''2011 Minnesota State Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 9 July 2011, using the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]] pool. The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2011 Bespin Regionals.pdf]]). These sheets are in the Players Committee's Bespin Regionals PDF but are headed "MN States" or "MN Weekend Day 1".

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
* '''Site:''' Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 9 July 2011
* '''Winner:''' —
